title: Release notes — Cursor Cost Tracker (1.0.1)
intro: Clearer Statistics cards, extra Last N metrics, and Current that stays on the personal monthly cap for enterprise accounts.

sections.name: New features
items: **Statistics** — median cost per query, cache hit, cost per 1M tokens, and an input/output/cache mix bar on the Last N summary.
**Billing cycle** — elapsed progress and reset date on the cycle chip; plan name shown as a badge.

sections.name: Improvements / Fixes
items: **Statistics** cards use even heights, stronger number hierarchy, and a warning tint when queries exceed the token threshold. Today no longer shows a fake full bar when there is no daily budget.
**Statistics** Status bar and Billing cycle cards no longer overlap. Cache hit now explains that the percent is prompt tokens reused from cache.
**Current** on enterprise / team accounts uses the personal monthly dollar pool (typically used / $250), not the large org leftover cap.
**Today** daily budget keeps at least one working day when only a weekend remains in the month.
